summary: Compare vendors and purchasing options using transparent lifecycle-cost and risk criteria.
intents: compare three vendors for our CRM
what is the total cost of ownership over five years
should we buy or build this tool
score these supplier bids against our criteria
assess vendor lock-in and contract risk
prerequisites: business need, required outcomes, and non-negotiable constraints
vendor proposals or comparable supplier evidence
budget, time horizon, and procurement policy where available
verify: The same weighted criteria were applied to every option
Lifecycle cost includes licences, migration, support and exit
The recommendation survives reasonable weight changes
